algorithm.Title: Bed Bug Bite - Female (Child)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Child | Female
Definition: Qatar-localized UAT-only adult and pediatric pathway for suspected bed-bug bites, screening for anaphylaxis, infection, extensive reactions, immune risk and environmental/safeguarding concerns; not approved for production.
FirstAid: Call Qatar 999 immediately and follow dispatcher instructions. If the patient has their own prescribed adrenaline auto-injector, use it according to its plan. Keep the patient lying down unless breathing is difficult; do not let them stand or walk and do not drive. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Are throat or tongue swelling, breathing difficulty, faintness, confusion, or collapse the main concern?
questions.Information: Systemic allergic-reaction features require the Anaphylaxis pathway.

questions.Question: Are the lips, mouth, throat, or tongue suddenly swollen, is the person struggling to breathe, or has anyone lost consciousness or become floppy?
questions.Information: NHS.UK insect bites and stings guidance lists these as signs of a serious allergic reaction (anaphylaxis) requiring an immediate 999 call.

questions.Question: Is the skin around the bites hot, red, and painful, or is pus or fluid coming out (signs of infection)?
questions.Information: NHS.UK guidance flags these infection signs as needing pharmacist advice or a primary-care review.

questions.Question: After emergency and infection features are excluded, are these presumed bed-bug bites requiring confirmation and safe symptom/environmental advice?
questions.Information: The cause cannot be confirmed remotely, and pediatric, pregnancy, medication and vulnerable-household risks require clinician review in this UAT pathway.

advice.Title: Emergency allergic reaction precautions
Content: Call Qatar 999 immediately and follow dispatcher instructions. If the patient has their own prescribed adrenaline auto-injector, use it according to its plan. Keep the patient lying down unless breathing is difficult; do not let them stand or walk and do not drive. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: symptoms persist or recur; loss of consciousness.

advice.Title: Routine bite follow-up
Content: Keep the area clean and book a routine review for signs of infection.
Call Back If: increasing redness or pain; fever develops.

advice.Title: Clinical and environmental review for presumed bites
Content: Avoid scratching, gently clean affected skin, and arrange clinician or pharmacist review before medication is selected. Use a licensed pest-control process appropriate to the household; do not apply pesticides to skin or improvise chemical treatments.
Call Back If: pain, spreading redness, discharge or fever; allergic reaction symptoms.

references: NHS.UK, "Insect bites and stings", https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/insect-bites-and-stings/ (page last reviewed 01 June 2023)
